svg.title: The path of a serving request
svg.desc: A serving request. The client (an app, SDK or AI gateway with a gd- API key) calls the API layer on port 8181, which checks IP rules, looks the API key up in a cache, resolves the model in its in-memory routing table and picks a replica (the nearest one that is not busy, or round robin or weights). The request goes to the node agent over its outbound mutual-TLS tunnel (or the 9443 proxy in direct mode) and on to the engine on 127.0.0.1, which runs on its GPUs or a slice. Tokens stream back frame by frame with the model name rewritten. After the last frame a usage event is queued and a worker writes and rolls it up hourly. There is no database read on the request path, failover to another replica happens before the first byte, and engines are never reachable from the network.
